note: The one home of the namer's numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (The namer) and its wireframes 11a to 11e. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels. The namer gives one mibi a name with the six keys alone. It stands over Habitat's right column (the card and the modules) and leaves Habitat's living window and the mibi in it uncovered, so the player names what they see.

overlay.layer: the face's top layer, over the screen it opens from and under the message plate
overlay.beneath: the screen beneath keeps drawing (its living window plays) and takes no key; its regions do not move
overlay.focus: while the namer is open its own graph (focus below) is the only one; on close the screen beneath gets its focus back as `close.focus` says
overlay.uncovered: Habitat's living window and its resident, x 16 to 624: the namer starts at x 632
overlay.open: a cut, no transition; the frame's title stays the screen's (Habitat)

opens.meet: Habitat's meet, the first ✓ with the ring on the new mibi: ✓ Name {name}. Any other key ends the meet with the default kept, and does what it does
opens.rename: Habitat's card name, a focus target `name` (ring round): ✓ Rename {name}, on any mibi at home, bonded or with you

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc

compositions.keyGrid: the namer's keys: each key a `panel` (the kit's instrument panel) with one `text` label, registering its own focus target at its rect; the characters per key come from props (keys.page, keys.caps), never from the spec. Used by the namer alone; a second user (the Companion, the Caddy) makes it a word, back to the UI designer and the architect
compositions.nameField: the name well: a `panel` (`ground` fill, `hairline` edge), the name as `text` at 28 px semibold, a selection rect behind it and a caret rect after it

fieldStates.selected: the name as opened, or a suggestion: the whole name on the selection fill, no caret. A key replaces it; ← clears it
fieldStates.typed: the caret after the last character; a key appends; ← deletes the last character
fieldStates.empty: the caret at the start; ← closes the namer, writing nothing

panel.note: the report card's look: panel fill, hairline edge, bevel top row, a void drop shadow; it covers Habitat's card (640, 48, 368, 216) and modules (to y 464), 8 px from the window's bezel (x 624)

field.widest: ten of the widest allowed letter (W at 28 semibold, 29 px with LVGL's rounding) measure 290 px: x 672 to 962; the caret ends at 966, 18 px inside the field's edge

selection.rect: x 668, y 70, the name's width + 8, 36 tall

caret.at: 2 px after the name's last ink advance, y 74 to 102
caret.when: typed or empty; none while selected

say.shows: the reason Done cannot save the name now, in `mist`; a refused press shows its reason in `amber` for 4000 ms (the message plate's time), then the line returns to `mist` or empty. Empty while the name can be saved

keys.ids: key.0 to key.27, index = 7 × row + column; a key whose page has no character in that place is not drawn and is not a target

states.on: hairline fill (one step up, as the open tab), label bone: the next letter in the other case

page.label: strings.keys.accents on the letters page, strings.keys.letters on the accents page, in the grid's case

done.label: strings.keys.done
done.dim: label `mist` while the name cannot be saved

keys.pagesRule: letters: a to z in reading order, then the hyphen and the apostrophe ’; accents: one column per vowel (a, e, i, o, u), one row per accent (acute, grave, circumflex, diaeresis), and ç ñ œ ÿ in the sixth column; the seventh column is empty
keys.case: the grid shows capitals while the field is empty or selected (a name starts with a capital) and small letters after; Aa gives the next letter in the other case, then the grid returns. At the start Aa does nothing (no ✓ cap; context strings.startCapital). Capitals: A to Z, Á to Ü, Ç Ñ Œ Ÿ; the hyphen and ’ have no case
keys.space: a space, typed like a mark
keys.marks: space, hyphen and ’ are the separators: refused first (strings.refuse.first), refused beside another (strings.refuse.twice); refused last only at Done (strings.refuse.last)
keys.limit: a character past NAME_MAX is refused (strings.refuse.full); while the field is full the letter and mark keys and their ✓ cap show dimmed
keys.suggest: the next name of the pool (state.peekNames(st, 12), not consuming), selected; each press the next, after the last the first. With no name to give: no ✓ cap, context strings.noSuggest
keys.done: saves when state.nameProblem is null: the cleaned name equal to the mibi's name is Keep and writes nothing; otherwise state.renameMibi, then events.named and the namer closes. Refused: the say line's reason in amber, nothing closes
keys.back: selected: clears the field (empty); typed: deletes the last character; empty: closes the namer, writing nothing
keys.room: closes the namer, writing nothing, and opens the room's top (frame.json navigation.roomKeys)
keys.idle: the namer closes, writing nothing, before Idle starts
keys.dock: the namer stays open; the crates wait in the bay, as on any screen but Home

focus.rule: three groups and the edge forms of lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1: `key` (key.0 to key.27), `mod` (mod.shift, mod.space, mod.page) and `act` (act.done, act.suggest). Inside a group the pad goes to the nearest target more than 6 px ahead ({ nearestIn, ahead }); where there is none the ring stays ("none" last), so the ends stop and nothing wraps. ▼ from the last row of keys, and ▲ ▼ between the rows of the bottom, take the target of the next group nearest the ring's column ({ nearestIn }). The bottom row's three keys are each as wide as the columns they stand under, so ▼ from any key lands on the key under it
focus.order: props.focus.targets lists the present keys key.0 to key.27, then mod.shift, mod.space, mod.page, act.done, act.suggest: on an equal score the earlier wins, so ▼ from the space bar, as near Suggest as Done, lands on Done
focus.reach: every key is reached from Done in at most 7 presses (Done ▲ page, then the grid); at most 8 between any two targets
focus.ringClear: a ring is 4 px outside its lifted key: 48×48 on a 48 pitch, so neighbouring rings meet no key and the ring above clears the row by 2 px
focus.held: while events.named plays the face moves no focus and sends no intent

named.target: the name regions of the screen beneath (Habitat's card name, and the meet ribbon while it shows)
named.do: the namer closes (a cut); the new name stands where the old one stood, with the frame's 240 ms flash behind it (as a counter's)

key.action: ✓ strings.type (the character as the key shows it: strings.typeSpace, strings.typeDash, strings.typeApostrophe for the marks), dimmed while the field is full
key.back: by the field: strings.backClear, strings.backDelete or strings.backLeave

shift.action: ✓ strings.capitals or strings.smallLetters; at the start of a name no ✓ cap

suggest.action: ✓ strings.suggest, then strings.suggestAgain while a suggestion shows; no ✓ cap with no name to give

done.action: ✓ strings.keep when the name is the mibi's own; else ✓ strings.name; dimmed (the frame's mist cap) while the name cannot be saved

bottomLine.widths: measured at Inter 16 with the widest ten-letter name: ✓ Name it W×10 221 px, ✓ Keep W×10 203 px, inside the action zone's 356; the context strings.context 175 px with the longest species name, inside 208

strings.name: Name it {name}
strings.startCapital: a name starts with a capital

refuse.twice: One space or dash at a time

strings.widths: the say line holds 312 px at 16: the longest, "{holder} has that name" with a ten-letter holder at its widest, is 267
strings.by: the slots and today's words, the UI designer's; the words are the copywriter's to confirm

nameLabel.widest: the widest allowed character at each size, measured on the face's baked fonts with LVGL's sum (per glyph (adv_w + kern + 8) >> 4): Inter 16 regular œ, W, Œ 16 px; Inter 20 medium œ, W, Œ 20 px; Inter 28 semibold W 29 px; Mibi 7×9 advance 6 (m, w, œ and most capitals)
nameLabel.rule: every box that sets a mibi's name holds NAME_MAX of the widest character at its size, on the 8 px grid: 160 at 16, 200 at 20, 296 at 28; never clipped, never an ellipsis
